==Description==
'''D-60ii''' is one of the many Entities you may find within [[Section D]], it being the 60 following [[D-60]] and [[D-60i]], He works like [[D-60i]], but a lot harder.

==Behavior==
Just like [[D-60i]], but takes 9 seconds to rebound (once he starts moving when he hits the door), breaks 2 doors and also much faster than [[D-60i]].

In phase 2, '''D-60ii''' will emit a very loud fake despawn sound version of the original [[D-60i]], and then will play a very speed-up version of the [[D-60i]] phase 2 start. '''D-60ii''' will almost always leave only 1 locker on the last rooms every time he hits and break 1 or 2 rooms. In this phase, it will only break 1 door.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* If '''D-60ii''' spawns in your run, you should refuse to open any doors and let '''D-60ii''' despawn by itself.
* That's because, if a time waster entity like [[A-200]], [[A-200i]], [[D-5]] or [[M-70]] spawns, '''D-60ii''' might destroy so many doors meanwhile these entities are spawned, that [[Void|Void Wall]] will kill you.
* Rush much as possible when '''D-60ii''' rebounds, as it breaks 2 rooms at once, it's very easy to fall behind.
** And that's the intention. '''D-60ii''' was meant to make you fight to reach the main room while he rebounds nonstop, so fight him best as possible, and use dodge rolls if necessary.

==Trivia==
* '''D-60ii''' has a 1 in 1000 chance to replace [[D-55ii]] once it attempts to spawn.
* Unlike [[D-60i]], '''D-60ii''' can't spawn any entities upon breaking the door, as '''D-60ii''' is very fast and is meant to make you have to rush to the main room each time he arrives to avoid getting catched by the void wall. And if '''D-60ii''' spawned someone, it is likely that you would die.
* A long time ago, everyone in lobby had been morphed to '''D-60ii,''' (07/18/25) causing a huge chaos.
** [https://youtu.be/ZXxhC6l3W4U?si=9L8s6od1G_fYxxTR Video] 
*'''D-60ii'''<nowiki/>'s fake despawn sound is very loud, so make sure to lower your volume when you notice that '''D-60ii''' will trigger phase 2.

* '''D-60ii'''<nowiki/>'s sound is the same as [[D-60i]], but modified to sound more distorted/funny.
* '''D-60ii'''<nowiki/> is bigger than [[D-60i]].
* '''D-60ii''' when despawning in his phase 2 will make 14 constant explosions very rapidly before making a bigger one and despawning.
* '''D-60ii's''' jumpscare sound is actually the same as [[D-60]] or [[D-60i]] one but except it's slowed down deeply.
* '''Astra''' created '''D-60ii'''.
